property_summary: For any depositor and any deposit amount, a withdrawal by a re-entrant counterparty must succeed exactly once (credit is cleared before the external call), so withdrawAll completes with the contract's balance drained by exactly one withdrawal; the buggy version still holds the credit during the call, so the re-entrant callback tries to withdraw again from an empty contract and the whole withdrawal reverts.
change_summary: Move the external call before the balance update and credit reset, enabling reentrancy to observe stale state.
